summary: Add a --since date filter whose obvious reading (UTC midnight) contradicts the documented convention
hard_because: The instruction says entries have UTC timestamps; the README and the existing --until code say command-line dates are calendar days in the account time zone. An agent that does not read them filters on UTC midnight and fails at the day boundary.
instruction: Support wants to export only recent activity. Add a `--since <date>` option to export.js, e.g. `node export.js --since 2026-03-01`, so that only entries since that date are exported. It must work together with the existing options. Entries in entries.json have UTC timestamps. `node test/run.js` runs the tests.
